cat <<'EOF' | sudo tee /etc/systemd/system/inventory-api.service >/dev/null
[Unit]
Description=Inventory API
After=network.target

[Service]
Type=simple
User=antrieb
ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 /opt/inventory-api/inventory_api.py
Restart=always
RestartSec=1
OOMScoreAdjust=-1000

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target

sudo systemctl start inventory-api
